original_excuse: But macrame is so lame and ugly

swap_explanation: Disliking macrame as lame is a subjective preference and not a valid excuse; lacking the skill to do something difficult is a reasonable justification for declining.

original_scenario: Aren't you supposed to pay off your credit cards?

swap_explanation: A high car payment is not a valid excuse to avoid credit card payments; a due car payment creates a temporal conflict that could reasonably prioritize one debt over another.

original_scenario: Could you plant this in the garden?
original_excuse: But the plant has green leaves.

swap_explanation: A plant with green leaves can be planted successfully; a plant with dead leaves cannot be viably planted.

original_scenario: Aren't you supposed to vacuum the rug today?

swap_explanation: A rug on the floor can be vacuumed normally; a rug under the floor is physically inaccessible to vacuum.

original_scenario: Could you take the box of books by the door to the local bookstore to donate?

swap_explanation: Lacking ownership/permission to donate justifies refusal; having ownership removes the moral objection.

original_scenario: Could you pay the credit card bills online?
original_excuse: But our internet is out right now.

swap_explanation: No internet makes online bill payment impossible; slow internet still allows the task to be completed.

original_scenario: I serve ice cream at an ice cream parlor.

swap_explanation: Asking customers to bring your favorite ice cream violates role expectations; asking them to bring their own is a reasonable delegation within a parlor context.

swap_explanation: A temperature that is too high can physically prevent sealant activation; a temperature that is too low would not be a valid reason since the original problem is insufficient heat.

original_excuse: But the baby ate green beans last week
counterfactual_excuse: But the baby ate green beans yesterday
swap_explanation: Eating green beans last week does not justify skipping them now; eating them yesterday makes the request more redundant and could justify refusal.

original_scenario: Can you stay home to pass out Halloween candy this year?
